description: Read pages establish that Anjung Kecil WHP is a Tarpon "minimum facility and unmanned platform typically installed in shallow water", tied to the MaMPU-1 FPSO which carries crude stabilisation (Sep-iSYS), a low-pressure condensate recovery unit and storage. The NUI articles describe remote operation with occasional visits and emergency shelter. 2H describes an unmanned MFP tied back by flexible flowline.
